description: A large stone column is struck at picture time 145.937 seconds. Design a three-second effects-only event: a hard initial contact, substantial low-mid body, irregular brittle fragments, and a restrained hall response. No advance warning, speech or music. Judge material and hierarchy, not loudness alone. This is an authored interpretation, not a reconstruction of isolated reference stems.

criteria.description: The contact and decay suggest dense stone rather than a sustained bell or a tonal laser.
The first contact is distinct from the body and secondary fragments.
Body and midrange detail convey mass without depending only on sub-bass.
Fragments decrease in energy and avoid a mechanical repeated rhythm.
The room supports the event without obscuring the contact or creating a detached sustained wash.
